task_context.problem_statement: When the base-12 integer $1531_{12}$ is divided by $8$, what is the remainder?
task_context.reference_solution: We have $$1531_{12} = 12^3 + 5\cdot 12^2 + 3\cdot 12 + 1.$$Note that $12^2$ is divisible by $8$, so $$1531_{12} = (\text{a multiple of 8}) + 3\cdot 12 + 1.$$Therefore, the remainder upon dividing $1531_{12}$ by $8$ is the same as the remainder upon dividing $3\cdot 12+1$ by $8$. This remainder is $\boxed{5}$.
